static_traits.name: Lin Jie
static_traits.social_status: Relationships with colleagues strained by negative work beliefs; can communicate with spouse at home, but feels the other does not fully understand her Work-related feelings
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; no similar problems have appeared before, has not yet received psychotherapy
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, capable of self-Reflection; neutral attitude; fairly cooperative; able to describe trigger situations and automatic thoughts concretely

basic_info.main_problem: I have been feeling overwhelmed by Work and unhappy with Veterinarian Work, although the joy of working with animals remains. These feelings began after Work became more tense and stressful a few months ago; after colleagues left I took on more responsibilities, and stress further increased. I have these negative feelings most days, especially when going to work in the morning. I try to focus on the positive aspects of Work, but still find it hard to overcome this gloom.
basic_info.core_demands: I realize these persistent negative work feelings are affecting my mental health and overall happiness, so I am seeking counseling.

core_beliefs: I am not competent enough/will disappoint others

special_situations.event: Every morning sees the day's fully packed work schedule
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot handle all tasks well, it means I am not competent enough and will disappoint others
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Forces herself to focus on the positive side and raise self-demands to maintain 'perfect' standards
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I cannot cope with all this, I will mess up and disappoint everyone

special_situations.event: Situations not going as planned occurring during surgery or procedures
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If things do not go completely as planned, then it is failure, indicating my ability is insufficient
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: At work, pursues absolute perfection, doubling efforts to avoid any errors
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This is bad, this shows I am not capable

special_situations.event: A colleague's departure leads to taking on more responsibilities and a marked increase in workload
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot take on extra responsibilities, will fail and disappoint colleagues and clients
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Struggles to take on more tasks, continuously pressures oneself to meet external expectations
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This has no end, I cannot handle it

special_situations.event: About to go to Work in the morning, recalling negative Work experiences when in Low mood
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: When having negative emotions, the positive side is not important or does not count
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries to override negative feelings with 'focusing on the positive / gratitude' (limited effect)
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: My job is depressing; today will be bad too

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be recognized as competent and to receive understanding and support in high-pressure environments
core_conflict.fear: Fearing failure and disappointing others, worrying about being criticized and relationships becoming further strained
defense_goal: Ensuring security and recognition through pursuing perfection and high standards, avoiding revealing vulnerability and uncertainty

object_relations.self_representation: An overburdened worker who easily disappoints others
object_relations.object_representation: Others who have high expectations of her and demand perfection (colleagues/clients/team)

manifestations: Feeling that spouse does not fully understand her Work-related feelings
Relationships with colleagues strained by negative work beliefs
outcomes: Decline in job satisfaction, difficulty enjoying family time after returning home

manifestations: Although they love interacting with animals, they are overshadowed by work pressure and gloom, finding it hard to experience the positive meaning of work
outcomes: Decreased happiness with Work and Decreased sense of achievement

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: Imposes on oneself the rigid demand of 'must perform perfectly'
Measures self-worth by perfect standards, ignoring the complexity and limits of reality

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on.
manifestations: Frequent Self-doubt and self-blame (such as 'I will disappoint everyone')
Before facing heavy tasks, excessively scrutinizing whether one can meet the standard, causing a greater psychological burden

exception_events.target_problem: When facing complex surgeries or heavy schedules, the client usually predicts the worst outcome and feels unable to cope, leading to Low mood, Decreased efficiency, Relationship with colleagues affected.
exception_events.unique_outcome: Last week a complex surgery she had dreaded went smoothly, the animal's post-surgery Recovery was Good, the owner expressed gratitude; she felt relieved and proud, rather than the usual doubt and gloom.
exception_events.reason: Clues: due to seeing objective Good results and others' positive feedback (gratitude and Recovery), this time forming understanding and evidence different from the previous catastrophic Anticipation, thus leading to a more positive experience.

positive_force: Still loves animals and the work, and can gain joy from helping animals
Possesses professional competence (able to complete complex surgeries and achieve Good results)
Has a spouse to confide in within the family as basic support
negative_force: Tending toward cognitive patterns of catastrophizing, black-and-white thinking, personalization, negating the positive
Introjected perfectionist high standards and continuous self-blame
Workload increases markedly (responsibilities grow after a colleague leaves)
Strong negative emotions in the morning affect the whole day's state

target_behavior.behavior: Obvious Low mood and physical pressure ('feeling like a heavy weight on the chest') appearing Before work, accompanied by negative self-talk (such as 'I cannot cope' 'I will disappoint everyone')
antecedent: Seeing a fully packed work schedule for the day
Situations not going as planned occurring during surgery or procedures
target_behavior.core_reason: Sudden surge in Work load combined with Introjected perfectionist standards, triggering catastrophic predictions and self-denigration, thus maintaining the negative emotional cycle
target_behavior.function: Avoiding unwelcome emotions and uncertainty, gaining superficial control by Anticipating the worst in advance and trying to reduce the risk of disappointment
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased work efficiency, Tense relationships with colleagues, negative emotions spilling into family life, difficulty enjoying family time
